subject: FCPS Study update: Double A Notes are now available! + more
html:
📚 Big Update!

Assalam o Alaikum! 👋

We've been working hard to add more content to FCPS Study, and here's what's new:

🌐 New Website URL!

We have a new, easier-to-remember address: fcps.study

Just type fcps.study in your browser to access the app!

📖 Double A Notes (3rd Edition)

All chapters from Double A Notes 3rd Edition are now available! This includes:

  • Physiology
  • General Pathology
  • Systemic Pathology
  • Anatomy
  • Neurology
  • Microbiology
  • And more...

📝 SK 21 Vol 1 Complete

All papers from SK 21 Vol 1 are now uploaded, including non-medicine specialty papers!

🎟️ New Credits System

We've introduced a credits system to give you more flexibility:

  • Each credit unlocks one paper of your choice
  • All users start with 5 free credits
  • Pick ANY 5 papers you want to unlock!

🎁 Early Bird Offer Reminder!

Want lifetime access to ALL papers? 8 out of 10 early bird slots are still available!

👉 Reply to this email with "Early Bird Offer" to secure yours!

Happy studying! 📖

— The FCPS Study Team

Questions? Just reply to this email!
